en.t: Six plum blossoms had opened on the branch...

units.source_text: 他用指尖不停地转动着。

en.t: He kept turning it with his fingertips.

units.source_text: 一停止转动，梅花的雄蕊不禁使他愕然。

en.t: As soon as he stopped turning it, the stamens of the plum blossoms startled him.

units.source_text: 这是他有生以来第一次看到梅花的雄蕊。

en.t: It was the first time in his life that he had seen the stamens of plum blossoms.
